map.Nx = floor((W+缝隙)/(小片宽+缝隙))，Ny 同理；自动尝试横竖: Nx = floor((W + kerf) / (piece width + kerf)), and Ny likewise; both orientations are tried automatically and the better one is used.
map.横向切割次数 = Nx（沿高度方向切 Nx 条/或 Ny 段），纵向同理；总切割: Horizontal cuts = Nx (cut Nx strips along the height, or Ny segments), vertical likewise; total cuts ≈ (Nx + Ny − 2).
map.2mm 约 4~5kg，3mm 约 5~6kg，5mm 约 6~8kg，8mm: 2 mm about 4 to 5 kg, 3 mm about 5 to 6 kg, 5 mm about 6 to 8 kg, 8 mm about 8 to 10 kg, 10 mm about 10 to 12 kg. The thicker the glass, the larger the wheel angle.

map.📚 深度解析：玻璃原片切割排版与利用率: 📚 In-depth: glass sheet cutting layout and utilization
map.下料优化：给定原片与小片尺寸，求可裁数量与最省排版方向: Cutting optimization: given sheet and piece sizes, find the piece count and the most economical layout direction
map.成本估算：由利用率、切割次数与总长度估算材料与工时: Cost estimation: estimate material and labor from utilization, number of cuts and total length
map.设备设定：按厚度推荐划割压力（刀轮载荷）: Equipment settings: recommend scoring pressure (wheel load) by thickness
map.算法：单方向排版 nx=floor((原片宽+刀缝)/(小片宽+刀缝))、ny=: Algorithm: single-direction layout nx = floor((sheet width + kerf) / (piece width + kerf)), ny = floor((sheet height + kerf) / (piece height + kerf)), pieces = nx × ny; compare the normal orientation with the one rotated 90° and take the larger. Utilization = (pieces × piece area) / (sheet area) × 100; cuts = nx + ny − 2; total cutting length = nx × sheet height + ny × sheet width; scoring pressure by thickness lookup (2 → 4.5, 5 → 7, 8 → 9, 12 → 12.5 kg and so on). Requires all sizes > 0 and kerf ≥ 0.
map.例1（原片 1830×1220×5mm，小片 400×300，刀缝 3mm）：正: Example 1 (sheet 1830 × 1220 × 5 mm, pieces 400 × 300, kerf 3 mm): normal nx = floor(1833/403) = 4, ny = floor(1223/303) = 4 → 16 pieces; rotated 90° nx = floor(1833/303) = 6, ny = floor(1223/403) = 3 → 18 pieces, so 18 rotated pieces are used; utilization 18 × 400 × 300 / (1830 × 1220) × 100 = 96.7%; cuts 6 + 3 − 2 = 7, total length 6 × 1220 + 3 × 1830 = 12810 mm = 12.81 m; pressure (T = 5) = 7.0 kg. Example 2 (sheet 2440 × 1830 × 8 mm, pieces 500 × 600, kerf 4 mm): both orientations give 12 pieces; utilization 12 × 500 × 600 / (2440 × 1830) × 100 = 80.6%; 5 cuts, total length 14.64 m; pressure (T = 8) = 9.0 kg.
map.为什么旋转90°可能更多？: Why can rotating 90° give more pieces?
map.小片长宽比与原片不一致时，换方向能塞进更多列/行；本工具同时算正反向取优，可提升: When the aspect ratio of the piece does not match the sheet, switching orientation fits in more columns or rows; this tool computes both orientations and takes the better one, which can raise utilization by 5% to 15%. The kerf (saw cut or breakage loss) must also be counted in every gap, otherwise the piece count comes out too high.
map.划割压力怎么选？: How should scoring pressure be chosen?
map.刀轮载荷随厚度增大（2mm≈4.5kg、5mm≈7kg、8mm≈9kg、12mm: Wheel load grows with thickness (2 mm ≈ 4.5 kg, 5 mm ≈ 7 kg, 8 mm ≈ 9 kg, 12 mm ≈ 12.5 kg); too little leaves a shallow score that is hard to break, too much causes edge chipping; thin glass needs tighter pressure control together with cutting oil and wheel speed.

map.正向排版：Nx = ⌊(原片宽+锯缝) ÷ (小片宽+锯缝)⌋: Normal layout: Nx = ⌊(sheet width + kerf) ÷ (piece width + kerf)⌋
map.旋转 90° 交叉排版取片数较大者: Rotate 90° alternate layout and take the larger piece count

map.正向：列数 C₀ = ⌊(原片宽 W + 刀缝 k) ÷ (小片宽 w + k): Forward: columns C0 = floor((sheet width W + kerf k) / (piece width w + k)); rows R0 = floor((sheet height H + k) / (piece height h + k))
map.Rotate 90°：列数 C₉₀ = ⌊(W + k) ÷ (h + k)⌋；: Rotated 90°: columns C90 = floor((W + k) / (h + k)); rows R90 = floor((H + k) / (w + k))
map.片数 = 列数 × 行数；取两种方向中片数较多者，不模拟混合方向套裁: Pieces = columns × rows; choose the orientation with more pieces; mixed-orientation nesting is not modeled
map.材料利用率 = 片数 × w × h ÷ (W × H) × 100%: Material utilization = pieces × w × h / (W × H) × 100%
map.切割方案：先按行高切出 R 条通宽条带，再逐条按列宽切出 C 片: Cut plan: first rip R full-width strips at the row height, then cut C pieces per strip at the column width
map.横向通刀 = (R − 1) + 下侧余料修边（有余料记 1，否则 0）: Cross cuts = (R − 1) + bottom waste trim (1 if waste remains, else 0)
map.每条条带纵向通刀 = (C − 1) + 右侧余料修边（有余料记 1，否则 0）: Longitudinal cuts per strip = (C − 1) + right-side waste trim (1 if waste remains, else 0)
map.总通刀次数 = 横向通刀 + R × 每条纵向通刀: Total through cuts = cross cuts + R × longitudinal cuts per strip
map.总切割长度 = 横向通刀 × W + R × 每条纵向通刀 × 条带高: Total cut length = cross cuts × W + R × longitudinal cuts per strip × strip height
map.其他厚度按 4 + 0.7×mm 估算（上限 20kg）；实际须按刀轮与设备参数: Other thicknesses use 4 + 0.7×mm, capped at 20 kg; adjust to the actual wheel and machine parameters
map.分别计算正向（列宽=片宽、行高=片高）与旋转 90°（列宽=片高、行高=片宽），: Forward (column width = piece width, row height = piece height) and rotated 90° (column width = piece height, row height = piece width) are calculated separately; the larger count is selected. Only uniform orientations are compared; mixed nesting is not modeled.
map.按“先分行、再逐条分列”的直线通刀方案：横向通刀为分行刀数加下侧余料修边，纵向为: Straight through-cut plan (rows first, then columns within each strip): cross cuts are row divisions plus bottom waste trim; longitudinal cuts per strip are column divisions plus right-side waste trim. A single piece still incurs trim cuts when the sheet is larger.
map.下料粗算：给定原片与小片尺寸，比较正向与旋转 90° 两种统一矩形排版的片数与利: Rough nesting: given sheet and piece sizes, compare piece counts and utilization for forward versus rotated 90° uniform rectangular layouts
map.切割工时估算：按“先分行、再逐条分列”的直线通刀方案统计刀数与总切割长度: Cutting labor estimate: count through cuts and total cut length using the rows-first, then per-strip columns plan
map.厚度与刀压参考：按厚度查划割压力表，实际刀轮角度与油压仍须按设备参数调整: Thickness and wheel-load reference: use the thickness table for scoring pressure; actual wheel angle and oil pressure must follow machine parameters
map.算法：正向列数 C0=floor((W+k)/(w+k))、行数 R0=floo: Algorithm: forward columns C0 = floor((W+k)/(w+k)), rows R0 = floor((H+k)/(h+k)); rotated 90° columns C90 = floor((W+k)/(h+k)), rows R90 = floor((H+k)/(w+k)). Pieces = C×R; compare the two uniform orientations and take the larger count; mixed-orientation nesting is not modeled. Utilization = (pieces×w×h)/(W×H)×100%. Cutting uses a rectangular through-cut plan: rip R full-width strips at the row height; cross cuts = R−1 plus bottom waste trim; then cut C pieces in each strip at the column width; longitudinal cuts = C−1 plus right-side waste trim. Total cuts = cross cuts + R×longitudinal cuts per strip; total length = cross cuts×W + R×longitudinal cuts per strip×strip height. All dimensions >0, kerf ≥0; with zero pieces both cuts and length are 0.
map.例1（原片 1830×1220×5mm，小片 400×300，刀缝 3mm）：正: Example 1 (sheet 1830×1220×5 mm, piece 400×300, kerf 3 mm): forward columns floor(1833/403)=4, rows floor(1223/303)=4 → 16 pieces; rotated columns floor(1833/303)=6, rows floor(1223/403)=3 → 18 pieces, so the rotated 6×3 layout is selected. Utilization 18×400×300/(1830×1220)×100=96.7%. Rotated strip height 400 mm: cross cuts (3−1)+bottom trim 1=3; longitudinal cuts per strip (6−1)+right trim 1=6; total 3+3×6=21 cuts; length 3×1830+3×6×400=12690 mm=12.69 m; pressure(5 mm)=7.0 kg. Example 2 (sheet 2440×1830×8 mm, piece 500×600, kerf 4 mm): forward 4×3=12 pieces, rotated 4×3=12 pieces, use forward; utilization 12×500×600/(2440×1830)×100=80.6%; cross cuts (3−1)+bottom trim 1=3, longitudinal per strip (4−1)+right trim 1=4, total 3+3×4=15 cuts; length 3×2440+3×4×600=14520 mm=14.52 m; pressure(8 mm)=9.0 kg.
map.为什么旋转 90° 可能更多？: Why can rotating 90° yield more pieces?
map.小片长宽比与原片不一致时，换方向能改变沿宽、沿高各自能排的列数与行数。本工具只比: When the piece aspect ratio differs from the sheet, rotating changes how many columns and rows fit along width and height. This tool compares only forward and rotated uniform orientations and selects the larger count. Mixed-orientation nesting may fit more, but requires nesting software or manual review.
map.切割次数为什么不是 Nx+Ny−2？: Why is the cut count not Nx+Ny−2?
map.旧式 Nx+Ny−2 假设只切内部网格线，单片或需要裁去边料时会算成 0 甚至负: The old Nx+Ny−2 formula assumed only internal grid lines; with a single piece or edge waste it could yield 0 or even a negative number. This tool uses an explicit rows-first, then per-strip columns plan: cross cuts include bottom waste trim, longitudinal cuts per strip include right-side waste trim, and zero pieces means zero cuts.
map.表中压力只按厚度给出参考（2mm≈4.5kg、5mm≈7kg、8mm≈9kg、1: The table is only a thickness-based reference (2 mm≈4.5 kg, 5 mm≈7 kg, 8 mm≈9 kg, 12 mm≈12.5 kg). Actual pressure also depends on wheel angle, oil pressure, cutting speed, glass composition and machine condition. Too light leaves a shallow score that is hard to snap; too heavy chips the edge. Confirm by trial cutting with the manufacturer parameters.
